title: Synthetic Data Generation for COVID-19 & Cardiovascular Data using CTGAN, TVAE & CopulaGAN
summary: A healthcare analytics project that generates synthetic COVID-19 and UCI heart-disease tabular datasets to preserve patient privacy and enable downstream model training, comparing SHAP-based interpretability across generators. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, along with SDV's evaluation functions (run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality), directly on both datasets.
needs: standalone 'from ctgan import CTGAN' is imported but no direct call site was found in evidence, so its use beyond SDV's wrapper is unclear
